rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 11: "This supplementary is a starting map drawn from a small sample of practitioners the AE101 research surfaced through OODA cycles in May 2026." 'OODA' is the repo's internal continuous-research-system term (root CLAUDE.md: "Research (OODA, findings, KB, signals)") and this file's own maintainer <!-- backing --> block uses an 'OODA' section header (line 204) for that exact machinery. Checked across the AE101 corpus (grep for 'OODA' in curriculum/lectures/composing-the-workflow.md and curriculum/lectures/the-loop-has-a-name.md above their own maintainer cuts): zero body hits anywhere. The term is never earned for an AE101 student in any file that ships to a room. Harm: a reader has no way to know what an 'OODA cycle' is or why it should carry any authority for them; it reads as an internal process credential leaking into the reading list's own framing.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Swap for a plain mechanical description the student doesn't need to decode, e.g. "...surfaced through the curriculum's own research process in May 2026" or just "...surfaced during research in May 2026."
